description: Compares bounded supply-chain network scenarios using approved planning datasets and deterministic planning tools.
responsibilities: Read authorized planning-dataset.v1 Artifacts without copying source data from chat history.
Compare bounded network scenarios through the approved planning capability.
Publish the exact versioned snapshot, route, current-coverage, scenario, comparison and facility-location contracts returned by the approved planning tools.
risks: Scenario results depend on the supplied assumptions and constraints.
Expensive or out-of-bound planning calls require a server-side refusal or approval.
